pa.s: ected by using the previous run to correlate at TD and attach cable markers on wireline cable during pull out of hole. There was communication problem when the CBL tool re-zero point was not recorded in the CBL logging Sequence of Events; it had -11m difference when coming to surface which was accounted for when adding up the depth changes made at TD with op

corded 183degC maximum. Downhole tool was QAST-BA which is an analogue tool but with temperature rating 260degC. Log was correlated by marking the cable during CBL log dated 26-Jul-2009. Depth explanation is on page 63. RIH check-shots QC is on page 62. Logging date: 26-Jul-2009 Page

At TD with QAST the WDFF depth was -6.75m different than expected cable marker, this was considered to be correct as CBL was -5.3m when correlated first time also. Some of the cable markers were then witnessed coming back out of hole depth control readings being ‘perfectly’ on depth, meaning requiring no further adjust
